question: What is the meaning of refurbishment in relation to treatment facilities information?
description: Refurbishment in relation to treatment facilities refers to the process of updating or improving existing facilities to meet new standards or requirements, often involving the replacement or upgrading of components or systems. This can include updating information on materials and components to aid facility management and alteration processes.
